claims.domain: fixed-SHA release and differentiated PostgreSQL/MinIO recovery
claims.doc_section: 发布、PostgreSQL 备份与 MinIO 图片存储
claims.conclusion: release.sh accepts only a lowercase 40-character commit SHA, resolves it exactly and requires reachability from origin/main; the release build context is tied to the selected tracked commit and script gates include environment/migration preflight, service drain, database backup/restore drill and health checks. backup.sh creates a custom-format PostgreSQL dump and checksum pair, validates the archive, then requires a configured restic repository and stores the pair in B2 with retention of 7 daily, 4 weekly and 6 monthly snapshots. Production MinIO is single-node with one named data volume; deployment docs explicitly say no external image backup exists and disk loss can destroy map/object images.
